other_conditions: No family member should be employed in government service (Class 1/2/3) or a higher category post.
Benefits on birth of a child are limited to the first or second child of a couple.
Applicant must have either the birth of a child or the death of a family member to be eligible.
Benefits are distributed only in the specified districts for each case.
benefits_summary: Provides 50 kg of wheat, rice and cooking utensils on the birth of a child, and 1 quintal of rice or wheat to families on the death of a member, depending on the district.
